clauses.title: Parties and Purpose
clauses.content: This Master Trade Framework Agreement is made between MERIDIAN DEMO BUYER PRIVATE LIMITED, Registration No: U74999MH2021PTC368921, Address: Level 12, World Trade Tower, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai, MH 400051 ("Buyer") and MERIDIAN DEMO SELLER GMBH, Registration No: HRB 189422, Address: Speicherstraße 42, 20457 Hamburg, Germany ("Seller") on 12 November 2026. It sets the legally binding framework for commercial purchase and sale transactions entered into through or recorded on the Meridian Trade Systems platform. [AMENDED TERMS FOR AUDIT TEST]

clauses.title: Independent Commercial Relationship
clauses.content: Buyer and Seller are the exclusive contracting parties for each transaction. Meridian Trade Systems is a software and trade orchestration platform only. Meridian is not a principal, buyer, seller, broker, distributor, guarantor, carrier, insurer, escrow provider, money transmitter, or payment custodian merely because it provides software, records affirmative electronic acceptance, or displays workflow status.

clauses.title: Transaction Formation
clauses.content: No binding purchase or supply obligation arises until both parties affirmatively accept a Transaction Schedule identifying the goods or services, quantity, specifications, price, currency, delivery terms, payment terms, and relevant milestone dates. Each accepted Schedule forms a separate and enforceable commercial transaction under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Goods, Specifications and Quality
clauses.content: Seller must supply goods matching the description, specifications, samples, standards, and documentation stated in the relevant Transaction Schedule (Food-grade flexible packaging film (BOPP 25-micron barrier rolls); HS Code: 3920.20). Any tolerances, quality certificates, packaging standards, and non-conformance remedies must be expressly agreed and recorded in Schedule A.

clauses.title: Price, Invoicing and Payment
clauses.content: The Transaction Schedule states the unit price, total price (EUR 125,000), applicable taxes, invoice requirements, payment milestones, and due dates. If an external payment provider or banking institution is utilized, its independent terms govern processing. Unless a separate signed agreement expressly provides otherwise, Meridian does not hold funds, provide escrow, or guarantee payout.

clauses.title: Delivery, Risk and Title
clauses.content: The Schedule specifies the delivery location (Nhava Sheva Port, Mumbai (INNSA)), target delivery date (2026-12-15), transport responsibility, and Incoterms® 2020 rule (CIF Nhava Sheva (INNSA), Incoterms® 2020). Risk of loss and title transfer are governed by the chosen Incoterms rule and named port/terminal. Incoterms allocate transport obligations, costs, and risk; they do not by themselves determine title transfer or payment finality.

clauses.title: Inspection and Acceptance
clauses.content: Schedule A states the objective inspection period (10 business days post-discharge), acceptance criteria, sampling method, certified third-party surveyor requirement (e.g., SGS/Bureau Veritas), and procedure for formal rejection or cure. Inactivity, silence, or automated system status alone does not constitute commercial acceptance unless expressly agreed in writing.

clauses.title: Telemetry and Evidence
clauses.content: The parties agree that environmental sensors, GPS trackers, bill of lading documentation, photos, and platform audit logs may serve as supporting factual evidence under Schedule C (IoT Telemetry & Evidence Protocol). Telemetry may be incomplete or subject to hardware outage; automated readings or AI classifications are advisory and do not constitute conclusive legal proof.

clauses.title: AI and Electronic Agents
clauses.content: An automated agent or AI model may perform only the limited workflow actions specifically authorized in Schedule B, within stated monetary and operational thresholds. Any action involving disputed facts, missing evidence, material price adjustments, waivers, contract amendments, or penalties strictly requires affirmative human approval.

clauses.title: Non-Conformance and Remedies
clauses.content: The parties establish in the Schedule the procedure for prompt notice, investigation, replacement, repair, price adjustment, or refund. No automatic penalty will be imposed unless the operational trigger, calculation formula, liability cap, evidence standard, and human review window are expressly agreed.

clauses.title: Representations and Compliance
clauses.content: Each party represents that it is duly organized, has full corporate authority to execute this Agreement, will comply with all applicable trade, export-control, sanctions, anti-bribery, tax, product safety, and data protection laws, and has completed corporate KYB verification on Meridian.

clauses.title: Confidentiality and Data
clauses.content: Each party must protect the other's proprietary commercial data, formulations, customer lists, and transaction pricing. Information uploaded to Meridian must not infringe third-party intellectual property or violate applicable trade secrecy laws.

clauses.title: Force Majeure
clauses.content: Neither party is liable for failure or delay caused by events beyond reasonable control (war, embargo, government trade sanctions, natural disasters, catastrophic port closures), provided it notifies the other within 5 days and mitigates impact. If Force Majeure continues for 60 days, either party may terminate without penalty.

clauses.title: Liability and Insurance
clauses.content: The Seller maintains marine cargo insurance covering 110% of CIF value under Institute Cargo Clauses (A). Aggregate commercial liability under each Transaction Schedule is capped at 100% of the total transaction value, except for willful misconduct, gross negligence, or breach of confidentiality.

clauses.title: Term, Suspension and Termination
clauses.content: This Master Framework begins on the effective date and continues until terminated upon 30 days written notice. Either party may terminate immediately for material breach not cured within 30 days or corporate insolvency. Termination does not cancel already executed Schedules unless legally mandated.

clauses.title: Disputes and Governing Law
clauses.content: This Agreement and all associated Schedules are governed by the laws of England and Wales (or as mutually agreed in Schedule D). Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this contract shall be resolved in accordance with Schedule D (Dispute Resolution Schedule), with legal seat in London (or Singapore) under SIAC / ICC Arbitration rules.

clauses.title: Electronic Records and Signatures
clauses.content: The parties consent to the use of electronic records, secure cryptographic hashes, and electronic signatures under applicable electronic transactions law. Meridian retains the immutable document version, signer corporate authority metadata, timestamps, and audit trail. A SHA-256 hash confirms document integrity.

clauses.title: General Provisions
clauses.content: This Framework and its accepted Schedules constitute the entire commercial understanding between the parties regarding the subject matter. Amendments must be in writing and bilaterally approved on Meridian. If a Schedule conflicts with this Framework, the Schedule prevails for that transaction only.

clauses.title: Purpose and Authority Scope
clauses.content: This Schedule records the parties' express consent to specified electronic contracting workflows and limited automated assistance on Meridian. It supplements the Master Trade Framework and does not grant any AI or algorithmic agent unrestricted legal authority.

clauses.content: Platform: Meridian Trade Systems (Release 2.4 / Enterprise SaaS). Authorized Buyer Admin: buyer.demo@meridian.test. Authorized Seller Admin: seller.demo@meridian.test. Each party must maintain active corporate authorization registries.

clauses.content: The parties authorize Meridian automated processes to: (a) generate draft trade documents; (b) compute mathematical totals; (c) verify SHA-256 document hashes; (d) notify parties of milestone dates; and (e) run automated sanctions list screenings. clauses.title: Limits and Human Approval Gate
clauses.content: Human approval by the designated Authorized Representative is mandatory for any commercial term modification exceeding EUR 0.00, any timeline extension exceeding 48 hours, any acceptance of non-conforming cargo, and any formal legal notice.

clauses.title: Attribution and Corporate Responsibility
clauses.content: Each party is responsible for permissions granted to its own credentialed users and authorized digital keys. Electronic actions taken within valid credentials will be attributed to that party under applicable law.

clauses.title: Revocation and Credential Compromise
clauses.content: A party may revoke digital agent or user permissions at any time through the administration console. In the event of suspected key compromise or unauthorized access, the affected party must notify Meridian and the counterparty within 12 hours.

clauses.title: Electronic Signatures and Acceptance Protocol
clauses.content: The parties consent to electronic execution. The platform records signer name, corporate title, email address, UTC timestamp, display timezone, IP address, and cryptographic document hash receipt code.

clauses.title: Cryptographic Integrity and Hashing
clauses.content: Meridian computes SHA-256 digests over all finalized agreements and transaction records. A cryptographic hash proves that the document content has not been altered since execution; it does not substitute for corporate signatory authority.

clauses.title: No Universal Legal Presumption
clauses.content: The parties acknowledge that electronic agent statutes and evidentiary rules vary across jurisdictions. This Schedule records contractual agreement but does not override mandatory local statutory formal writing requirements.

clauses.title: Automated Permissions Register
clauses.content: Permission 1: Anomaly Alerting (Threshold: ±5% variance; Auto-notify Buyer & Seller). Permission 2: Sanctions Check (Daily batch scan across 6 regulatory sources). Permission 3: Hash Validation (Instant on file upload).

clauses.title: Protocol Scope and Status
clauses.content: This Protocol governs the collection, preservation, and evidentiary review of digital sensor data, GPS tracks, temperature logs, and photographic evidence. Digital telemetry provides rebuttable factual evidence but does not automatically determine legal liability.

clauses.title: Device Registration and Calibration
clauses.content: Devices: Sensitech TempTale Ultra or equivalent NIST-traceable dataloggers. Calibration valid within 12 months. Serial numbers and installation positions must be recorded in the shipping container packing manifest.

clauses.title: Data Integrity and Identity Verification
clauses.content: Telemetry payloads uploaded to Meridian must include tamper-evident device identifiers, monotonic sequence numbers, and SHA-256 data block signatures. Raw payload strings are preserved immutably.

clauses.title: Physical Placement and Redundancy
clauses.content: Sensors must be placed on pallet top-surface and container door bulkhead. Battery capacity must exceed transit duration by at least 30 days. Backup manual USB reading is required upon container de-stuffing.

clauses.title: Evidence Metadata Standards
clauses.content: Every telemetry record retains: Transaction ID, Container ID, Device Serial, UTC Timestamp, Temperature (°C), Relative Humidity (%), Battery %, Shock Vector (G), and Network Signal Strength.

clauses.title: Loss of Signal and Grace Period
clauses.content: A telemetry gap during deep-sea oceanic transit is normal and does not constitute cargo damage or contractual breach. A 72-hour grace period applies before an unexplained outage triggers an investigation notice.

clauses.title: Photographic and Document Evidence
clauses.content: Container stuffing photos and seal affixation photos must show container number, high-security bolt seal number, and date/time metadata. Photos are stored with SHA-256 hashes to prevent post-upload tampering.

clauses.title: Data Retention and Access Control
clauses.content: Telemetry records and photographic evidence are retained for a minimum of 7 years in read-only encrypted cloud storage, accessible only to credentialed Buyer, Seller, and administrative dispute reviewers.

clauses.title: Conflicting Evidence and Review Protocol
clauses.content: If sensor telemetry conflicts with destination physical inspection findings, the parties will pause automated milestone transitions and order a joint survey by an independent accredited surveyor.

clauses.title: Evidentiary Audit Package Export
clauses.content: In the event of an unresolved dispute, Meridian will generate a comprehensive cryptographic Audit Package containing raw sensor streams, device calibration certificates, upload hashes, and timestamped event logs.

clauses.title: Party Evidentiary Obligations
clauses.content: Seller is responsible for sensor placement and seal recording at origin. Buyer is responsible for seal inspection and recording container condition before unsealing at destination. Falsification of evidence constitutes material breach.

clauses.title: Dispute Framework Purpose
clauses.content: This Schedule establishes the mandatory stepped dispute resolution procedure for all claims arising out of or related to this commercial trade. Meridian provides workflow facilitation and records preservation only; Meridian does not act as an arbitrator or judicial forum.

clauses.title: Operational Escalation Notice
clauses.content: A claimant party must submit formal notice specifying the disputed invoice, shipment, defect, or milestone delay with supporting documents. The responding party must acknowledge within 2 business days and provide a substantive reply within 5 business days.

clauses.title: Good-Faith Senior Negotiation
clauses.content: Senior commercial officers of Buyer and Seller (Elena Vance and Marcus Thorne) will engage in good-faith negotiations within 10 business days following the notice. They may agree to commercial price adjustments, cargo re-testing, or replacement deliveries.

clauses.title: Preservation of Evidentiary Records
clauses.content: Both parties must immediately freeze and preserve all physical cargo samples, sensor logs, communications, and transport documents. Discarding or altering evidence creates an adverse evidentiary inference under applicable arbitration rules.

clauses.title: Interim Mitigation Measures
clauses.content: While a dispute is pending, the parties will take reasonable steps to prevent spoilage or deterioration of goods. Meridian does not hold or freeze funds unilaterally unless external payment rails support conditional hold instructions.

clauses.title: Mediation Window
clauses.content: If senior negotiation does not resolve the dispute within 15 business days, the parties agree to submit to non-binding commercial mediation administered by the Singapore International Mediation Centre (SIMC) or London Maritime Arbitrators Association (LMAA).

clauses.title: Binding Arbitration & Forum
clauses.content: Any dispute not resolved by mediation within 30 days shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) under the SIAC Rules in force. Legal Seat: Singapore. Language: English. Arbitrators: One sole arbitrator appointed by SIAC. Governing Law: English Law.

clauses.title: Urgent Relief and Enforcement
clauses.content: Nothing in this Schedule prevents either party from seeking urgent conservatory or interim relief from an emergency arbitrator or competent court of law to preserve assets or evidence. Any arbitral award is final and enforceable under the 1958 New York Convention.

clauses.title: Costs and Confidentiality
clauses.content: The prevailing party in any arbitration is entitled to recover reasonable legal fees, expert expenses, and arbitration institution costs. All dispute proceedings and filings must remain strictly confidential.

clauses.title: Meridian Platform Limited Role
clauses.content: Meridian provides platform logs, hashes, and document records in response to lawful tribunal orders or joint written requests. Meridian does not adjudicate claims, provide legal counsel, or guarantee compliance with arbitral awards.
